name: Las Vegas
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Las Vegas for 2026, and here is what he found: 31 family events, 16 of them free. The magic runs from November 6 (Glittering Lights at Las Vegas Motor Speedway) through January 18 (Rock Rink and Holiday Train at Downtown Summerlin), with the Downtown Summerlin Holiday Parade (November 28), the Holiday Tree Lighting at Las Vegas Civic Center (December 4) and Cowboy Christmas and Classic Car Show at Floyd Lamb Park (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Las Vegas

  • 31 Christmas events for kids in Las Vegas
  • 16 free events, including the Downtown Summerlin Holiday Parade, the Holiday Tree Lighting at Las Vegas Civic Center and Reindeer Winterfest at Cimarron Rose Community Center
  • Meet Santa: Santa Chalet at Downtown Summerlin (through December 24), Cowboy Christmas at Floyd Lamb Park (December 5) and Unidos Por Los Ninos (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Downtown Summerlin Holiday Parade (Fridays and Saturdays, November 28 to December 19) and the Civic Center Holiday Tree Lighting (December 4, 6:10 pm)
  • Trains: Rock Rink holiday train at Downtown Summerlin ($7), mini train rides at Cowboy Christmas and The Polar Express movie at Windmill Library (November 29)
  • Season: November 6 to January 18
